prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Reordering sign-in after pet or companion selection, live wait countdown timers, and personality-driven or refreshed path headlines consistently won.
Targeted sign-in security and persistence hints, path duration hints, and photo processing hints won, whereas account recovery hints hurt and many other hints showed no clear effect.
Specific split-layout redesigns (photo upload, wait screen) and select desktop control guide screens won, while sub-flows, trait selectors, and major redesigns hurt or showed no clear effect.
Reordering sign-in after photo upload, desktop companion story copy, and estimated time headlines hurt performance; audio chimes, notifications, adoption badges, and incentive callouts showed no clear effect.
Predictions overestimated gains for sub-flows, story copy, post-photo sign-in reordering, and major layout redesigns.
Predictions underestimated gains for targeted hints, personality headlines, live wait timers, and effective control guide screens.

Changes:
0: [sign_in, hint] Multi-Device Pet Sync Persistence Hint: Displays a hint on the sign-in screen informing users that signing in safely binds their pets to their account so existing pets are restored on any device. (why: Support received 8 emails regarding pets missing or resetting after signing in again.)
1: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Companion Interaction Overview Screen: Adds a dedicated onboarding screen right before the final home welcome screen detailing how to hide, wake, and interact with the pet. (why: Support logged 3 tickets about user confusion on controlling, hiding, or talking to the pet post-onboarding.)
2: [choose_path, redesign] Companion Path Stage Layout Redesign: Redesigns the choose path selection screen into a step-focused stage layout. (why: Path choice step has high mean duration (514s); layout clarity helps users pick quickly.)
3: [adoption, redesign] Pet Choice Stage View Redesign: Rebuilds the pick friend screen using a stage layout with a step counter indicator. (why: Adoption step has an 80% conversion rate and median 89s completion time; structured stage layout improves adoption speed.)
4: [home, wait_info] Desktop Pet Desktop Arrival Progress Hint: Adds explicit status copy on the waiting screen explaining that the custom pet is rendering and will automatically pop up on the desktop when finished. (why: Support received 3 emails about pets not displaying on the desktop and 3 emails about custom generation glitches.)
5: [sign_in, reorder] Reorder Sign-In Immediately After Path Selection: Moves the sign-in screen immediately after the path choice step before pet customization begins. (why: Securing account creation upfront prevents account loss issues reported in 8 support emails.)
6: [adoption, hint] Photo Generation Accuracy Hint: Adds a hint on the photo upload screen explaining photo quality requirements for accurate 3D pet rendering. (why: Support received 3 emails reporting custom pet generation failures or distorted pet visual results.)
7: [finish, redesign] Home Welcome Centered Controls Layout: Redesigns the home intro screen into a centered layout with an added quick controls summary component. (why: The final step takes mean 5815s with 76.3% completion, and users frequently ask how to operate desktop controls.)
8: [choose_path, copy] Companion Journey Expected Duration Headline: Updates headlines on the path choice screen to state that path selection takes under 1 minute. (why: Clear duration expectations reduce user dropoff (currently 11.4% dropoff at choose_path).)
9: [home, notification] Generation Completion Desktop Notification Switch: Enables readiness notification alerts and live time estimates on the waiting screen during pet generation. (why: Home waiting stage has median 201s duration and 11.8% dropoff.)

scores.note: Targeted persistence hints consistently win and are backed by strong email evidence.
New screens at finish step historically hurt conversion despite support interest.
Major layout redesigns carry low historical success and tend to overestimate gains.
Adoption redesigns have averaged -1.5% in previous tests.
Progress hints address clear support complaints and align with wait timer wins.
Reordering sign-in right after path selection is a proven winning pattern.
Photo processing hints consistently win with minimal implementation cost.
Desktop control guides help, but finish redesigns generally drag conversion.
Estimated time headlines consistently hurt performance in past tests.
Notifications show mild positive effect but lag behind live countdown timers.
